explanation_full: Analyzing the correlation matrix reveals several strong relationships, most notably the correlation of 0.9601 between Butyrate and VFA, and 0.9428 between Acetate and VFA. These high positive correlations suggest that these metabolites tend to increase or decrease together, which is crucial for understanding the metabolic profile related to HPR. Furthermore, the correlation between Acetate and Butyrate (0.8651) reinforces the interconnected nature of these key organic acids in the system.
